title: Warehouse
description: Warehouse v1 contract. Warehouse must be a registry entry, not hardcoded; MISA mapping is reserved through integration contracts.
$comment: Sources: PACK-01 placeholder registry control; warehouse_type and status values fixed from the ops-core database check constraints ck_op_warehouse_type and the ACTIVE/INACTIVE lifecycle (SKU-M12-03, agreed with the business-platform M3-4, 13/11/2026). The same two vocabularies are published on the external projection schemas/ops/x03b/external-warehouse.schema.json.

warehouse_type.description: Warehouse type, closed set: RAW_MATERIAL (raw material warehouse) or FINISHED_GOODS (finished goods warehouse). Upper case, compared byte for byte. A new type is a contract change, not a data change.

status.description: Warehouse lifecycle status, closed set. INACTIVE is a lifecycle state, not a deletion: the warehouse stays in the registry and in the snapshot.
